description.value: Parklane Resort & Motel is a motel-class lodging in the Okanagan region. Specific amenities and cyclist facilities could not be verified as the business website was unavailable during assessment. The property appears open and publicly accessible as overnight accommodation.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website prefetch failed due to connection error, so verification relies entirely on OSM tags. OSM confirms the motel exists with WLAN internet access (verified 2023-06-13) and appears open (looks_closed=false). Cannot verify bike storage, staff procedures, or other amenities from available evidence.
concerns: Website prefetch failed (connection error)—primary source amenity verification not possible
Internet access data from OSM is 3+ years old (last verified 2023-06-13)
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real motel appearing open and publicly accessible. Website unavailable for amenity verification, but this does not preclude inclusion as viable overnight accommodation for touring cyclists.
